findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Inspector found sanitizer in the sanitizer bucket under prep line across from the hand sink to have 0ppm of Quat with the facility test strips. Quat in the 3 part sink as well as other sanitizer buckets is 200 ppm. Ensure that when buckets are pulled, the sanitizer is producing suds before it is added to the bucket. The bucket along with others was remade as it was time to change the buckets according to staff. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: The inspector observed the handle of the burger freezer next to car broiler to have a missing screw. Repair handle for the next routine inspection. 

(A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Inspector observed the following areas to have some excess soil: 1) floor drain under the 3 part sink 2) floor under the cabinet in the lobby 3) The cabinet under the frozen coke machine (syrup) 4) the area under the serving line with the two lips that hold soil (shown to manager). Watch for areas like this for extra cleaning and maintain clean. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
